base_contract.inheritance: All identity, rights, source-freshness, source-policy, authorization, indexing, and fail-closed rules remain unchanged unless this file explicitly overrides their Step-35 state or artifact hash.

release_policy: No article may be released until Step 36 independently accepts this browser-QA evidence, reruns the complete release suite, deploys, and verifies production.

private_article_preview_contract.access_model: authenticated D1-backed admin session; all anonymous, invalid, unknown, and encoded private-namespace requests fail as non-indexable 404 responses

required_headers.content_security_policy: default-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'none'; script-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'none'; font-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; connect-src 'none'

step_35_amendments.finding: At 390px the fixed-width chart and table increased the root document scroll width even though the figure itself was intended to be the horizontal scroll container.
step_35_amendments.resolution: The rendered preview now constrains the root and body inline size, isolates the figure with inline-size containment, and preserves horizontal scrolling inside the figure. Root overflow is false at all eight article/viewport combinations.

step_35_amendments.finding: Figure title and subtitle rendered without visible separation.
step_35_amendments.resolution: The figcaption is now a small grid with an explicit gap.

step_35_amendments.finding: The mobile horizontal chart/table region was not in the keyboard tab order.
step_35_amendments.resolution: Both figures now have tabindex=0, use the existing 3px focus indicator, and respond to horizontal arrow-key scrolling. Equivalent accessible tables and SVG descriptions remain present.

next_step.task: Perform the final release review, rerun all required gates, deploy only if all remain green, and verify the real production routes and controls.
